description: This file defines a React component for managing and displaying connectors, including filtering, loading, and connecting/disconnecting functionalities, along with sample mock data.

methods.name: loadConnectors
methods.description: Fetches the list of connectors from API or fallback mock data.

methods.name: filterConnectors
methods.description: Filters the connectors based on search criteria and updates the displayed list.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles user action to connect to a selected connector, opening the modal.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnecting a connector, with user confirmation and API call placeholder.

methods.name: handleConnectionSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful connection, resets modal and reloads connector data.
